handoff: Approve: all 3 criteria traced to core and harness tests (run-state file writes denied with the corrupt reason; relative/symlink/new paths resolved; reads, shell and other writes allowed); test and typecheck green; 1 minor (dangling symlink not followed).

findings.title: A dangling symlink pointing under run state is not resolved
findings.detail:
resolveWrite walks up while !existsSync(at); existsSync follows symlinks, so a symlink in the worktree whose target under runs/ does not exist yet (e.g. link.json -> <runs>/gh-9/new.json) counts as missing, its own name is appended to the realpath of its parent, and the write resolves to the worktree path and is allowed, while writing through the link creates the file under run state. Narrow case; the spec says the hooks are a reminder, not a sandbox.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Check with lstatSync (or readlink a link) before walking up, so a dangling link resolves through its target.
